propositions: Impact-present ticket close invokes commit_impact.referencing_commits which resolves historical reference candidates via resolve_ticket_id, calling os.listdir per non-alias candidate, causing O(unique_candidates × tracker_size) scaling.
resolve_ticket_id's 8-hex short-id branch and generic-prefix branch (len>=4) each perform a full tracker-root directory listing per candidate, while the alias branch was already bounded by an index.
The fix replaces per-candidate os.listdir calls with a single ResolverScanIndex built once per invocation, using bisect-based prefix matching on sorted directory names.
Non-alias historical candidates (short-id-shaped tokens, subject prefixes, deprecated four-digit references) now resolve in O(log store + matches) time instead of per-call directory scans.
Ticket matching semantics, ambiguity handling, descendant credit, file-impact-vs-diff enforcement, and fail-closed behavior remain unchanged.
